title: Campaign Objectives
objectives: Select the exact objective for real business scenarios
Avoid the common rookie trap of running 'Traffic' for sales

blocks.text: Meta gives you exactly what you ask for! Tell it the wrong goal, and you will waste your budget.
Meta uses Outcome-Driven Ad Experiences (ODAX) with 6 core objectives.

rows: Reach maximum people at lowest cost
Sending clicks to a website or blog
People likely to submit contact info
People with a habit of buying online

blocks.title: The Window Shopper Trap
blocks.text: If you ask a shop assistant for 'traffic', they will invite teenagers who just want to look at pretty dresses. If you ask for 'buyers', they will invite people carrying credit cards.
For local Indian businesses (salons, real estate, gyms, clinics), 'Leads' via Instant Forms or Click-to-WhatsApp is the top revenue generator.
Never choose 'Traffic' when you want sales. Traffic gets you cheap accidental clickers, not paying customers.

quiz.q: An online clothing boutique wants customers to buy sarees on their website. Which objective should they pick?
quiz.hint: Pick the objective that directly matches the money transaction.
quiz.explain: The 'Sales' objective instructs Meta's algorithm to hunt for users who actually complete online checkouts.

quiz.q: A dentist in Jaipur wants local patients to book consultation calls. What is the ideal objective?
quiz.hint: The dentist needs patient names and phone numbers.
quiz.explain: 'Leads' objective optimizes for contact inquiries via Instant Forms or direct WhatsApp conversations.

quiz.q: Why is choosing the 'Traffic' objective usually a mistake if your real goal is purchases?
options: Meta charges 10x more for traffic ads
Meta will find cheap clickers who rarely buy anything
Traffic ads only show on desktop
quiz.hint: Meta gives you what you ask for: clicks, not buyers.
quiz.explain: Traffic optimizes purely for link clicks. Many clickers leave within 2 seconds without ever purchasing.

quiz.q: True or False: If you change your mind about your objective after launch, you can simply edit the campaign objective dropdown.
quiz.hint: Can you change the blueprint once the house foundation is laid?
quiz.explain: False. Once a campaign is created, the objective cannot be edited. You must create a new campaign.

recap: Meta delivers exactly what you ask for: Awareness, Traffic, Engagement, Leads, Sales, or App Promotion.
For revenue, use 'Leads' for service businesses and 'Sales' for e-commerce stores.
